LanguageData.RR_DiscussionDescription: Discuss a larger or smaller preferred body range with another colonist. A real conversation can change their wishes or irritate them. It does not change their weight.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionNoRecipients: No eligible colonists are present on this map.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionOngoing: Keep discussing this fixed target when both colonists are free
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionFixedTarget: Fixed target for {0}: {1}–{2} {3}. A new order is needed to change it.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionLimits: Rest between discussions: {0} hours remaining. Recipient outcomes today: {1}/2. Irritation: {2}.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionIntentOn: Ongoing discussions enabled. They pause while either colonist is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionStopped: Discussions stopped. Existing cooldowns and outcomes remain.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionScheduled: Fixed target saved. Discussions will begin when both colonists are free and ready.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionUnavailable: Body discussions require two ordinary adult colonists with known body preferences.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionSameMap: Both colonists must be present on the same map.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionNotReady: Both colonists must be awake, mobile, conscious, able to speak and hear, and capable of social interaction.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionCooldown: A participant needs more time between discussions or has reached today's limit.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionUnreachable: The speaker cannot safely reach the recipient.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionNotLocal: The participants must remain together and able to interact.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionBusy: A participant is busy or already reserved for another activity.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionOutcome_NoChange: {0} and {1} finished their discussion without changing {1}'s preferred range.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionOutcome_Receptive: {1} considered {0}'s suggestion. Their preferred range moved toward the discussed target and their conviction softened.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionOutcome_Breakthrough: {1} adopted the body range discussed with {0}.
LanguageData.RR_DiscussionOutcome_Irritated: {1} felt pressured by {0}'s suggestion. Their preferred range did not change.
